entities.name: GBA1-like query protein
observations: 523-aa query matches reviewed human GBA1 (P04062) at 56.2% identity over 95.2% query coverage (E-value 1.68e-209); assignment is homology-based, not direct annotation.
Query contains Glyco_hydro_30 (PF02055) at residues 104–453 and Glyco_hydro_30C (PF17189) at 456–518.
Likely lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase: hydrolyzes glucosylceramide to glucose and ceramide; exact query substrate specificity is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: GBA1 P04062
observations: Reviewed human lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase; lysosomal targeting and membrane association are associated with SCARB2 and saposin C, respectively.

entities.name: Sphingolipid metabolism
observations: Human GBA1 is annotated in sphingolipid metabolism; a GBA1-like query may contribute to lysosomal glucosylceramide catabolism.

entities.name: Cholesterol metabolism
observations: Human GBA1 annotations include cholesterol metabolism and glucose transfer from glucosylceramide to cholesterol; relevance to query is inferred from homology.
